title: Cache-aside helper: within-TTL second read is a cache hit and origin is called once
asA: developer wrapping a downstream origin call with cache-aside
iWant: cache-aside.getOr to invoke origin once on miss, write back with the elicited TTL, and serve subsequent within-TTL reads from cache
soThat: the origin surface (a database, a downstream service) is spared one call per cached hit within TTL

acceptanceCriteria.description: On first call, cache-aside.getOr(key, originFn) finds nothing in the facade, invokes originFn once, writes back with the elicited TTL, and returns the fresh value with source origin. On the second call within TTL, the read is served from the facade (source cache) and originFn is NOT invoked (the invocation counter stays at 1).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh key and an origin function that increments a counter each call
acceptanceCriteria.when: getOr(key, originFn) runs twice within TTL
acceptanceCriteria.then: the invocation counter reaches 1; both calls return the same value; the second read reports source cache

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-6 TTL floor: cacheAside.getOr(key, originFn, {ttl:0.5}) with a per-call TTL below the 1-second floor per ADR-3202 clamps the effective TTL to 1 second before it reaches the facade. The kvWrite record on the write-back carries ttl:1 (not 0.5). A subsequent read at 500ms elapsed still returns cache (source cache); a read at 1001ms elapsed returns origin.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a cache-aside helper with a fake clock and getOr({ttl:0.5})
acceptanceCriteria.when: the write-back happens and reads land at 500ms and 1001ms
acceptanceCriteria.then: the kvWrite record carries ttl:1; the 500ms read is cache; the 1001ms read is origin

acceptanceCriteria.description: Origin throws: cacheAside.getOr(key, originFn) where originFn rejects with an application error surfaces the rejection unwrapped to the caller. No cache write happens; no kvWrite record emits; a subsequent getOr with the same key still finds nothing in cache and re-invokes originFn.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a cache-aside helper and an originFn that rejects on every call
acceptanceCriteria.then: both calls reject with the origin error unwrapped; no kvWrite emits; the invocation counter reaches 2

acceptanceCriteria.description: Concurrent misses (single-flight): two concurrent cacheAside.getOr(key, originFn) calls on a fresh key with the same originFn invoke origin exactly once; both callers receive the same value; the invocation counter reaches 1 (not 2). The single-flight boundary lives on the cache-aside helper, not on the facade.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a cache-aside helper and a fresh key
acceptanceCriteria.when: two concurrent getOr(key, originFn) calls fire
acceptanceCriteria.then: origin is invoked once; both callers receive the same value; invocation counter is 1

acceptanceCriteria.description: source classification present on every return: every cacheAside.getOr return value is wrapped in {value, source} where source is exactly "cache" on a hit and "origin" on a miss-then-fetch. A caller that inspects the source field can distinguish cache from origin without extra bookkeeping.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a cache-aside helper with one miss followed by two hits
acceptanceCriteria.then: the miss carries source:"origin"; both hits carry source:"cache"
